# SiriusXM Pays Tribute to Hip-Hop Icons Wu-Tang Clan with Launch of The Wu-Tang Clan Channel Presented by Rock The Bells Radio


November 02, 2026 5:44pm EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_2698fc4e503e479d2767612c26e8e36e/siriusxm/news/2026-11-02_SiriusXM_Pays_Tribute_to_Hip_Hop_Icons_Wu_Tang_2317.pdf)


***The Wu-Tang Clan Channel debuts November 4, celebrating the group's legendary music, cultural influence, and enduring legacy***


**NEW YORK, NY – November 2, 2026** – SiriusXM today announced the launch of The Wu-Tang Clan Channel presented by Rock The Bells Radio, an exclusive pop-up channel celebrating one of hip-hop's most influential groups and their lasting impact on music and culture.


The channel will be available to subscribers on the SiriusXM app from November 4 through December 1.


The Wu-Tang Clan Channel takes listeners deep into the Wu-Tang universe, featuring classic anthems, essential album cuts, iconic solo projects, and live performances. Fans will also hear exclusive interviews with Wu-Tang Clan members, rare stories behind the music, and special programming available only on SiriusXM.


The celebration extends to LL COOL J's Rock The Bells Radio, SiriusXM channel 43, where every Wednesday in November will be dedicated to all things Wu-Tang. These special Wu-Wednesdays will spotlight the group's more than three-decade career with music from their legendary catalog, exclusive commentary, behind-the-scenes insights, and personal reflections on the collective's influence and legacy.


Members of Wu-Tang Clan will also sit down in front of a live audience at SiriusXM’s Los Angeles studios for an exclusive Front Row Q&A event hosted by Peter Rosenberg on Thursday, November 12. The full conversation will air Friday, November 13 at 6pm ET on both LL COOL J’s Rock The Bells Radio and The Wu-Tang Clan Channel and will be available afterwards on the SiriusXM app. In celebration of the pop-up channel, SiriusXM subscribers and fans can enter for a chance to win a pair of tickets to attend a special Front Row with Wu-Tang Clan. Click[HERE](https://www.siriusxm.com/wutangclanfrontrowpr) for full details.


The Wu-Tang Channel presented by Rock the Bells Radio is a month-long celebration of one of hip-hop's most influential groups, as they celebrate Wu-Tang Clan Day in New York City honoring the release date of their 1993 landmark debut album and are inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall Of Fame.


Eligible customers can get their first three months of SiriusXM for free. Click[here](https://siriusxm.com/Get3mosFree) to sign up and experience all that SiriusXM has to offer. See Offer Details.


###


**About Wu-Tang Clan**
Founded in New York City's Staten Island in the early 1990s, the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees-elect Wu-Tang Clan comprises members RZA, GZA, Method Man, Raekwon, Ghostface Killah, U-God, Masta Killa, Inspectah Deck, Cappadonna, and the late Ol' Dirty Bastard (ODB).


Led by the production of RZA, samples from martial arts films have thematically appeared throughout the group's music, as have samples including Kung Fu films’ classical strings alongside soul legends like Isaac Hayes, Syl Johnson, James Brown and Rick James.


With a slew of gold and platinum releases, Wu-Tang Clan’s collective catalog spans over 85 LPs. More than just rappers, Wu-Tang Clan are entrepreneurs and successful cultural influencers, with an empire that features everything from clothing lines and video games to books and acting credits.


Considered by many to be the greatest hip-hop group of all time, Wu-Tang Clan have been touring as a unit since their debut record- Enter the Wu-Tang (36 Chambers)- came out in 1993. The now quadruple-platinum release vaulted the New York City group with songs like "C.R.E.A.M." (Cash Rules Everything Around Me) and "Protect Ya Neck" that are about as recognizable as anything in the rap canon.


Whether they're headlining their global farewell tour, Wu-Tang Forever: The Final Chamber or bringing tracks from GZA's seminal Liquid Swords and Raekwon's mafioso-minded Only Built 4 Cuban Linx…, while honoring the legacy of their departed brother, Ol' Dirty Bastard on stages worldwide, every Wu-Tang Clan show is a celebration of prolific careers as individuals and especially as the most storied group in hip-hop history.


**About Sirius XM Holdings Inc.**
SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, with a portfolio of audio businesses including its flagship subscription entertainment service SiriusXM; the ad-supported and premium music streaming services of Pandora; an expansive podcast network; and a complete ecosystem of advertising solutions through SiriusXM Media and AdsWizz. SiriusXM offers live, on-demand, and human-curated programming across music, talk, news, sports, and podcasts, and the company reaches approximately 255 million monthly listeners across its platforms. With deep automotive manufacturer relationships and unique spectrum assets, SiriusXM is built to reach listeners wherever they are. The company connects fans to the voices, creators, and moments they love - creating communities where listeners engage, participate, and belong.
